title: Stopped pair-star trees: conditional κ = 7.808981744031e-5
body:
## Selected conditional result

**κ = 7808981744031/100000000000000000 = 7.808981744031e-5.**

This update adds a binary pair-star exclusion tree and deterministic integer-weighted legal carrier exchanges to icekylinx's PR104 stopped product-ring/rational-center framework, with Rohan Arun's PR107 comparison producer and PR100 balanced transfer. It improves pinned PR107 by **0.13553%**. Subsequent [PR108](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/108) and [PR109](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/109) report stronger candidates; **no current-record claim is made**. Further combinations are being investigated separately.

## Construction and complete accounting

The pair-star prefix/suffix chain is replaced by a binary exclusion tree. A fixed integer price table makes 604 legal cardinality-preserving matching exchanges and then reaches a fixed point. The full recursive profile is regenerated from every actual edge and frame operation.

- Complex h=24, m=576, 44,340 additions, 8,120 roots, 7,194 matched carriers.
- R=45,266, W=191,429,920, recursive rank=110,261,771,840, largest child=552.
- Exact complex saving **4880994746013/62500000000000000**.
- All copied centers, both data connectors, inverse correction, signed wrappers and exact divisor 21 remain paid.
- Three nested row reserves have coefficient 1176, degree 4000 and exact positive gap 40024/25.

The larger role count compared with PR107 is offset by an improved complete child moment. This is an asymptotic exponent refinement, not a runtime benchmark.

## Reproduce and evidence

```sh
python3 research/stopped-pairtree/verify.py
# equivalently:
make stopped-pairtree-verify
```

Requires Python 3.11+ and C++17; the new package uses the Python standard library. The original PR104/107 complex constructors and exact certificates are freshly reproduced in scratch, followed by the selected graph and byte-identical matching. The unchanged coarse bit producer and ordinary leaf are inherited, source-pinned inputs; their moments and row reserves are rechecked.

Independent audits check **all 4,096,576 signed coefficients**, actual binary-frame nondegeneracy and containment, all 7,194 carrier edges, all 45,266 role lifetimes, and the full 76,670-operation literal program. Constructive elementary-shear inversion proves the scalar arbitrary-dirty identity; four signed fixtures check its implementation. Finite full-factorization, atom-ring and ordinary-wrapper controls accompany the written transfer review. Independent rational arithmetic checks the full paid recurrence, adjacent-grid exclusions, all 47 positive constraint slacks and seven cost margins, with ten corruption controls.

The complete seven-stage selected gate passed in **14.778 seconds with zero frozen-file drift**. Python 3.11/3.14 component reproductions agree. The inherited joint-dual integration gate passed in **160.792 seconds**, preserving its mathematical payload and updating only the three root-file pins and their derived metadata hashes. All 331 imported files match original Git blob IDs.

- Source manifest SHA256: `7dc682264ac44b13c336643c17ffce06663e6fb936954ba94bf8575e3588b31d`.
- Certificate SHA256: `28cb74eb564186321fee6adffb58c2160a192fe8c2334391ad7cb06f5e061833`.
- Current head: `b79fbc4b289cc4740e4fe92dd347c5f5f36becfb`.

The expanded 60-job CI matrix is pending on this update. The preceding saturated-deferred head passed [all 57 jobs](https://github.com/tomdif/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/37860932394). Default verification writes temporary outputs only; `--record` writes separate run receipts.

Original licenses and AI-assistance disclosures are archived unchanged.

The earlier saturated-deferred result, matching the concurrent PR103 value 6.398282083297e-5, remains intact alongside the merged-span/deferred-storage construction. See `research/stopped-pairtree/PROOF.md`, `physical-proof.md` and `balanced-transfer.md` for the new composition.

All PR104 newly proposed atom-streaming, stopped ordinary-interface and odd-grid contracts, plus inherited analytic and all-size fixed-tape hypotheses, remain explicit dependencies. The finite checks do not prove the entire multiplication theorem or constitute independent human review. Draft pending maintainer review.
